name: mock-plaque
prompt: Photorealistic product photograph for a brand presentation slide. Background: a modern university media studio corridor, warm grey plaster wall, soft daylight from the left. Subject: a round brushed brass plaque mounted on the wall with the attached circular seal logo engraved and filled with deep navy (#0E4A84) enamel, the small folded corner of the monogram in gold. Details: crisp engraving edges, subtle reflections, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens. Constraints: keep the seal and monogram shape exactly as the reference, no extra text, no university crest, no watermark.

name: mock-sign
prompt: Photorealistic interior photograph. Background: a professional lecture-video recording studio with a teleprompter, softbox lights and a glass lightboard, dark navy acoustic panels. Subject: a large backlit dimensional sign of the attached monogram logo in matte white with a gold accent, mounted on the navy wall. Details: soft halo glow behind the letters, cinematic but natural lighting, eye-level view, 35mm lens. Constraints: logo shape identical to reference, no people, no other logos, no text except "HY FLIP".

name: mock-stationery
prompt: Photorealistic flat-lay stationery mockup. Background: ivory textured paper surface (#F7F5F0), soft top-down daylight with gentle shadows. Subject: business cards, an A4 letterhead and a navy folder printed with the attached HY FLIP monogram; gold foil on the monogram accent only. Details: premium cotton paper texture, slight emboss, a fountain pen at the edge. Constraints: monogram identical to reference, no fake Korean text (use simple grey lines for body text), no watermark.

name: studio-hero
prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a modern university lecture-video studio. A middle-aged Korean professor in a navy blazer speaks naturally toward a camera with a teleprompter, softbox key light, dark navy acoustic wall, a glass lightboard on the side. Natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, 35mm, calm and trustworthy mood, desaturated navy-grey palette. No logos, no text, no watermark.

name: flipped-class
prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a Korean university seminar room during an active discussion class. Korean students in their twenties in small groups around tables, a Korean professor in his 50s walking between them, laptops showing lecture video thumbnails, warm daylight from large windows. Candid moment, nobody looking at camera. East Asian features, natural skin tones. No logos, no readable text.

name: lightboard
prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a Korean professor in his 50s writing glowing equations on a transparent lightboard in a dark studio, the writing glows soft white and gold, rim light on the professor, black background. No readable brand text.

name: chroma
